description: This file contains Swagger API schema definitions and response models for the Standing Instruction History API resource in the Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects and response structures used for documenting and generating API documentation.

classes.name: StandingInstructionHistoryApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes that define the structure of the API response related to standing instruction history, including nested response classes and data item classes.

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionRunHistoryResponse
classes.description: Defines the top-level response object for the standing instruction run history API.

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionHistoryPageItemsResponse
classes.description: Represents individual items (pages) in the standing instruction history response.

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionHistoryPageItemsFromClient
classes.description: Models client information associated with a standing instruction history item.

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionHistoryFromAccount
classes.description: Models account information associated with a standing instruction history item.

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionHistoryToAccount
classes.description: Models destination account information for a standing instruction history item.

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionHistoryToClient
classes.description: Models client information for the recipient end of the standing instruction.
